image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a textured, rocky substrate covered in reddish and yellowish encrusting organisms. The chiton has an oval shape with visible dorsal plates surrounded by a girdle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is reduced without eyes or tentacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anterior end of the organism is visible and lacks any protruding sensory structures like eyes or tentacles, consistent with chiton anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front edge of the shell/girdle is rounded and blunt, showing no distinct head separation.
Surface appears smooth/leathery without antennae or eye stalks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dorsal surface protected by eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in linear series.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eight distinct transverse segments (valves) are clearly visible running from anterior to posterior, separated by sutures.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plates embedded in tough leathery girdle that may be smooth, spiny, or hairy.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct peripheral band (girdle) surrounds the central plates, appearing textured and leathery, holding the plates in place.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates exhibit a mottled brownish-green coloration with some translucency/sheen, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface features broad muscular foot for adhesion to rocky substrates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a dorsal view; the ventral foot is completely occluded by the body and substrate contact.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The organism sits low against the rock, exhibiting a flattened profile typical of intertidal grazers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Can curl into defensive ball when dislodged.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral capability, not a static visual feature observable in a single image of an attached specimen.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The plates have an unusually high-gloss, plastic-like sheen that differs slightly from natural calcareous textures, though this could be due to wetness/mucus. Edges between plates are slightly soft.
Slight inconsistency in depth-of-field blur; some background elements near the focal plane appear smeared rather than optically blurred.

Texture distinction between calcareous plates and leathery girdle

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' sheen on the plates. Is this a realistic wet-mucus reflection common in intertidal zones, or an AI-generated specular highlight artifact? Verify the plate count strictly; AI often generates 6 or 7 segments instead of 8.
